app.title: PPL Perplexity Analyzer
toolbar.analyzeHint: Send the full text to the backend to compute PPL (Ctrl+Enter)
toolbar.autoRefreshHint: Recompute whenever the text changes (no duplicate request while one is in flight)
toolbar.ignoreHint: Add the selected text to the ignore list (still sent to the model as context, but excluded from all statistics)
toolbar.savePresetHint: Save the current colors/style as a preset
toolbar.settingsHint: Color stops, rendering style, fonts, backend URL, etc.
histo.title: PPL distribution / layered window (token mode only)
histo.winDownHint: Move the window one width toward lower PPL
histo.winUpHint: Move the window one width toward higher PPL
histo.winTopHint: Only show the window with the highest PPL
histo.hint: Drag on the histogram to select the layered window
statusbar.tokensHint: Total tokens from the last analysis (updates with PPL). Click to re-analyze
statusbar.elapsedHint: Duration of the last PPL computation
statusbar.nllHint: Overall average NLL of the document (natural log; only measured, non-ignored tokens)
statusbar.pplHint: Overall average PPL of the document = exp(avg NLL); text color follows the heat-map palette
statusbar.coverageHint: Measurement coverage: chars covered by measured, non-stale tokens / total chars
modal.savePreset.title: Save preset
modal.savePreset.name: Preset name
modal.manage.title: Manage presets
modal.settings.title: Settings
modal.settings.stopsHint: PPL ≤ the lowest stop uses the endpoint color; ≥ the highest uses the endpoint color; gradient in between
modal.ignore.title: Ignore list
modal.ignore.empty: The list is empty. Select text and click “Ignore selection” to add.
toast.textTooLong: Text is {len} chars, exceeding the backend limit of {max}; trim it and retry
toast.selectFirst: Please select text to ignore first
toast.ignored: Ignored selection ({n} chars); it is excluded from the statistics
